name: Do I need to live in the main house if I rent out my Junior ADU?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to live in the main house if I rent out my Junior ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, current state law requires that the owner of the property must reside in either the primary dwelling or the Junior ADU. This is known as an 'owner-occupancy' requirement. The intent is to ensure that JADUs are primarily used to expand housing options while maintaining a level of oversight by the property owner. This regulation applies regardless of whether the JADU is rented out or used by family members.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, state law requires the property owner to reside in either the main house or the Junior ADU if one is built.
